dataset_name: Daily Mandi Wholesale Prices and Arrivals
provider: Open Government Data (OGD) Platform India / AGMARKNET
description: Official daily market transactions from registered APMC mandis across Indian states
fields_contained: State, District, Market, Commodity, Variety, Grade, Arrival_Date, Min_Price, Max_Price, Modal_Price, Arrivals
units: Prices: INR/quintal; Arrivals: Tonnes or Quintals
temporal_coverage: 2001 to present (Repository contains UP 5 districts Sep 2024 - Sep 2026)
licence: National Data Sharing and Accessibility Policy (NDSAP) Open
access_or_api_method: REST API with API Key / CSV bulk download
missingness_profile: Zero missing values in primary price fields; 15-25% Sunday market closure missingness; sporadic reporting pauses
known_limitations: Nov 2025 APMC renaming creates discontinuous market strings; arrival quantities frequently purged or unstandardized; multi-grade collision if Grade is omitted
join_feasibility_summary: EXACT JOIN - Direct source of existing raw CSV files

provider: Centre for Economic Data and Analysis (Ashoka University)
description: Cleaned, normalized, and systematically harmonized AGMARKNET daily time-series archive
fields_contained: State, District, Market_Name, Commodity, Variety, Modal_Price, Min_Price, Max_Price, Arrivals_In_Tonnes, Date
access_or_api_method: Direct web portal bulk query / Python API scrape
missingness_profile: Lower than raw OGD; standardized missing date interpolation flags provided
known_limitations: Normalized market names may slightly diverge from raw AGMARKNET local spellings; academic server query rate limits
join_feasibility_summary: HIGH - Primary candidate to retrieve missing daily arrival volumes for UP mandis

dataset_name: IMD Gridded High-Resolution Daily Rainfall (0.25 x 0.25 deg)
description: Daily gridded rainfall interpolated from ~3500 rain gauge stations across India at 0.25-degree resolution
geographic_coverage: Pan-India (0.25 x 0.25 degree spatial grid; ~27km x 27km)
update_frequency: Annual retrospective updates (with near-real-time updates via mausam portal)
access_or_api_method: Binary gridded files (.GRD) / NetCDF conversion via Python rasterio/xarray
missingness_profile: Complete spatial coverage across mainland India; zero missing grid cells
known_limitations: Spatial resolution (27km) aggregates localized convective microbursts; nearest grid centroid to APMC mandi required
join_feasibility_summary: HIGH - Spatial join via mandi latitude/longitude coordinates to nearest grid cell

dataset_name: IMD Daily Station Surface Weather Observations
description: Daily observatory measurements of surface temperature, humidity, rainfall, and wind speed
fields_contained: Station_Name, Station_ID, Date, Max_Temp, Min_Temp, Relative_Humidity_0830, Relative_Humidity_1730, Rainfall_24hr
units: Temp: deg C; RH: %; Rain: mm
geographic_coverage: Pan-India (~550 surface observatories; UP stations at Lucknow, Kanpur, Jhansi, etc.)
access_or_api_method: Web portal reports / data.gov.in Daily Weather Bulletin API
missingness_profile: Occasional missing station days (<5%); sensor maintenance gaps
known_limitations: Sparse physical station network (~1 station per district); rural mandis must interpolate from district HQ observatory
join_feasibility_summary: HIGH - Can be mapped via District centroid or nearest IMD airport observatory

dataset_name: District-Level Crop Area Production Yield (APY) Database
description: Official administrative statistics on crop sown area, production, and yield by district and season
fields_contained: State, District, Crop, Crop_Year, Season, Area_Hectares, Production_Tonnes, Yield_kg_per_ha
units: Area: Hectares; Production: Metric Tonnes; Yield: kg/ha
access_or_api_method: Web portal form query / CSV export
missingness_profile: Zero missingness for major staple crops; secondary crops have irregular reporting
known_limitations: Severe 12 to 18-month reporting lag; Advance estimates subject to major revisions; static annual figure does not explain daily price volatility
join_feasibility_summary: CONDITIONAL - Must be lagged by >= 1 full agricultural year to prevent lookahead leakage

dataset_name: Agricultural Statistics at a Glance & Advance Estimates
description: National and state-level crop production forecasts, MSP schedules, and trade flow statistics
fields_contained: Crop, Season, Estimate_Stage (1st/2nd/3rd/4th Advance / Final), Target_Production, Estimated_Production, MSP_Price
geographic_coverage: National and Major States (State-level for UP)
missingness_profile: Complete for major food grains and commercial oilseeds
known_limitations: State-level aggregates only (no district breakdown in advance estimates); substantial revision errors between 1st and Final estimates
join_feasibility_summary: MEDIUM - State-level macro signal; cannot resolve mandi-level micro disparities

source_authority: Ministry of Consumer Affairs, Food & Public Distribution
description: Statutory public warehousing storage tariffs and handling charges for agricultural commodities
fields_contained: Center_Name, State, Commodity_Category, Storage_Type (RWC/General/Cold), Weekly_Tariff, Monthly_Tariff, Handling_Per_Bag
units: Tariff: INR / bag or INR / quintal / month or slab
geographic_coverage: National network (UP Regional Office: Lucknow; centers in Lucknow, Ghaziabad, Jhansi, Kanpur)
known_limitations: Reflects formal public warehouse rack rates; smallholder farmers rarely utilize CWC directly due to lot size minimums (50+ qtl) and transit costs
join_feasibility_summary: HIGH - Used as audited benchmark for economic break-even hurdle rate (Phase 4 & 5)

dataset_name: WDRA Registered Warehouses and Negotiable Warehouse Receipts (e-NWR)
source_authority: Department of Food and Public Distribution
description: Registry of accredited agricultural warehouses eligible to issue electronic Negotiable Warehouse Receipts (e-NWR)
fields_contained: Warehouse_ID, Warehouse_Name, Operator, District, State, Mandi_Proximity_km, Capacity_MT, Commodities_Approved
missingness_profile: Complete registry of accredited facilities; unaccredited village godowns not captured
known_limitations: Does not publish real-time daily occupancy or space availability; only static capacity and accreditation status
join_feasibility_summary: MEDIUM - Spatial join by district to verify physical availability of accredited storage

dataset_name: ICAR-CIPHET National Post-Harvest Loss Assessment Studies
provider: Central Institute of Post-Harvest Engineering & Technology (ICAR-CIPHET)
source_authority: Indian Council of Agricultural Research / MoFPI
description: Comprehensive nationwide scientific survey of post-harvest crop shrinkage, physical loss, and spoilage across harvest and storage channels
fields_contained: Crop, Crop_Group, Farm_Harvest_Loss_pct, Storage_Loss_Farm_Level_pct, Storage_Loss_Commercial_pct, Total_Supply_Chain_Loss_pct
units: Loss: Percentage of total harvested weight (%)
geographic_coverage: Pan-India (Representative agro-climatic zones across 14 states including UP)
access_or_api_method: Published research reports / Ministry of Food Processing Industries table
missingness_profile: Static cross-sectional survey benchmarks; seasonal micro-fluctuations not tracked
known_limitations: Loss numbers represent cumulative channel-wide totals; 7-day tactical storage losses must be derived via empirical decay models
join_feasibility_summary: HIGH - Ground truth basis for parameterizing quantity loss fraction L in economic equations

dataset_name: Kisan Credit Card (KCC) Priority Sector Lending Guidelines & Subvention
source_authority: Reserve Bank of India / Ministry of Finance
description: Statutory interest rates, subvention guidelines, and post-harvest produce pledge loan terms for smallholders
fields_contained: Scheme_Name, Baseline_Interest_Rate, Subvention_Pct, Net_Farmer_Rate_pct, Post_Harvest_Pledge_Duration_Months, Max_Limit_INR
known_limitations: 7% baseline (subvented to 4% for prompt repayment) applies to formal bank credit; informal village moneylenders charge 24% to 36% p.a.
join_feasibility_summary: HIGH - Establishes audited financing carrying rate (i = 0.07 p.a.) in economic model

dataset_name: UP Rajya Krishi Utpadan Mandi Parishad Statutory Fee and Bye-Laws
provider: UP State Agricultural Marketing Board (Mandi Parishad)
description: Statutory mandi cess, development levy, and regulated palledari (labor handling) charges across UP APMCs
fields_contained: Mandi_Category (A/B/C), Mandi_Fee_pct, Development_Cess_pct, Loading_Charge_per_qtl, Unloading_Charge_per_qtl, Weighment_Fee
geographic_coverage: Uttar Pradesh Statewide (All APMC yards in 75 districts)
known_limitations: Informal cash cuts and unauthorized trade discounts often exceed statutory schedules in physical mandi yards
join_feasibility_summary: HIGH - Standardizes transaction cost baseline in sell vs store decisions

dataset_name: Petroleum Planning & Analysis Cell (PPAC) Daily Fuel Prices
description: Daily state capital and district retail pump prices of high-speed diesel (HSD)
geographic_coverage: Pan-India (District-level for major cities including UP)
access_or_api_method: PPAC portal / Oil Marketing Companies (IOCL/BPCL/HPCL) public feed
known_limitations: Captures fuel input cost, but does not capture return-trip empty freight backhauls or localized truck cartel premiums
join_feasibility_summary: HIGH - Joinable on State/District + Date; excellent exogenous proxy for agricultural freight volatility

dataset_name: Commission for Agricultural Costs & Prices (CACP) Price Policy Reports
description: Comprehensive price policy and Minimum Support Price (MSP) recommendations for Kharif and Rabi crops
fields_contained: Crop, Marketing_Season, MSP_Recommended, MSP_Approved, Projected_Cost_A2_FL, Projected_Cost_C2
access_or_api_method: CACP website / Press Information Bureau releases
known_limitations: MSP serves as effective price floor primarily for Wheat and Paddy where FCI procurement is active; weak floor for pulses/oilseeds
join_feasibility_summary: HIGH - Provides economic floor parameter for major crops (Wheat MSP = Rs 2,275 - 2,425/qtl)

description: Electronic trading portal aggregating mandi gate arrivals, electronic assaying parameters, and auction prices
fields_contained: State, Mandi, Commodity, Date, Min_Price, Max_Price, Modal_Price, Total_Arrival_MT, Assayed_Trade_MT
geographic_coverage: Selected accredited mandis (~1361 mandis across 23 states)
access_or_api_method: High missingness in assaying quality parameters; only ~30% of physical mandi trade is cleared through e-NAM
missingness_profile: Offline physical open-auction trade remains dominant in UP mandis; e-NAM volumes often reflect only a fraction of total yard arrivals
can_join_current_data: MEDIUM - Useful for cross-validating arrival volume and assaying quality grades
